headline: Etienne Haul Gives Blueballs the Edge Over CheesusJesus
verdict: Blueballs wins the current grade battle, with the stronger overall score and a much larger supplied package value.
summary: Kane’s Blueballs comes out ahead on the supplied numbers, earning an 86.6 overall score and 88.5 value score after turning DK Metcalf into Travis Etienne and Keenan Allen. Etienne is the centerpiece: his 84.4 value, 14.7 season average, and 19.8 recent average give Blueballs a meaningful running-back addition alongside Breece Hall and Rico Dowdle. Kade’s CheesusJesus receives the cleaner roster-fit score at 91 and consolidates two players into one wide receiver, but the return carries a 66.1 package value versus 121.3 for Blueballs. That makes this a practical consolidation for Kade, while Kane gets the stronger present-day asset haul. The Packers fan may call it efficient; the scoreboard calls it a loss.
